## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A two-fascicle variant recension of the *Mùlián wǔbǎiwèn* (cf. [KR6k0072](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0072)), preserved as Taishō T1483b. Translator and date unknown.

**Abstract**

The two-recension transmission of the *Mùlián wǔbǎiwèn* (T1483a vs. T1483b) reflects the textual variability characteristic of Vinaya-casuistic literature in early-medieval Chinese transmission. The "b" recension is fuller (two fascicles vs. one) and includes additional cases not in T1483a. Both recensions are commented on in the late-Míng works of [性祇](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%80%A7%E7%A5%87) ([KR6k0074](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0074)) and [永海](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B0%B8%E6%B5%B7) ([KR6k0075](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0075)).
